name: Maze Sequencer FX
_comment: Insert-effect variant of ../vst (same maze_seq_vst.cpp, parameters and skin): 'effect' makes gen_vst.py emit PLUG_EFFECT in params.h and a category=Effect plugin-list entry, so the sequencer loads as an insert and takes none of the 8 plugin instrument slots. Audio passes through untouched; notes go out the plugin's own ALSA port 'Maze Sequencer FX'. build.sh copies params.json, layout.conf, skin.css and images/ here from ../vst (not committed).
